Proof-carrying autonomy · FinTechathon 2026

AI proposes.
Proof decides.

Tell the AI what you want your treasury to do. QED checks your owner-signed limits, has an independent co-signer verify the action, then proves the execution quality on-chain. You stay in control; the agent cannot move funds on its own.

Try a real conversion → Test the safeguards Explore the evidence ↗
1 · Proposes

AI agent

Reads your instruction, plans the route, builds the proof. Holds no key that can pay alone.

2 · Re-derives

Co-signer

Separate process and key. Re-quotes from the chain and signs only what the owner allowed.

3 · Enforces

Contracts

Mandate, caps, ring-fenced liabilities, and the best-execution inequality. A worse route reverts.

4 · Verifies

Anyone

Receipts, bounds and proofs can be re-derived from the chain without trusting QED.

    Owner's signed mandate
    —

    The owner key in this sandbox is a development key held by the demo server, so you can play the owner. In production the owner signs in their own wallet. The AI can never sign a mandate, and the vault's on-chain daily cap (100 tUSD) still applies.

    Standing treasury policy
    Not signed

    The owner signs a target once. Each tick the agent decides how much to convert — X = min(need, market impact, policy cap, mandate cap, free funds) — the co-signer re-derives X, and the agent stops when the target is met.

    Certified execution

    A route is chosen. Its quality is proven.

    CONNECTING
    ≤
    A mathematical ceiling. An independently checked result.

    The contract compares actual output with a certified upper bound. The scope is the five owner-approved venues, with a tolerance of one part per million.

    The verification rule
    The check QEDExecution runs in every trade

    For any prices ν, no route through the owner's constant-product venues can return more than

    B(ν) = νin·A + Σvenues [(√(νbRb) − √(νaRa/γ))₊² + (√(νaRa) − √(νbRb/γ))₊²]

    The contract recomputes B from live reserves, rounding every step upward, and accepts only if out·10⁶ ≥ B·(10⁶ − τ), τ = 1 ppm. Any ν is a valid bound, so a proof cannot be forged; at the right ν the bound meets the optimum. Scope: the five owner-approved venues, not all of DeFi.
